login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Log in to get to your dashboard.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.description: A few details and your page can take shape.

checkEmail.title: Check your inbox
checkEmail.description: One more step and your account is ready.
checkEmail.sentTo: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to activate your account.
checkEmail.hint: Nothing there after a few minutes? Check your spam folder or have the link sent again.
checkEmail.resent: A new link is on its way.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your account's email address. We'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sentDescription: If there is an account for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.
forgotPassword.sentHint: Nothing there? Check your spam folder or request the link again.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: Pick a new password for your account. You'll be logged out everywhere afterwards.
resetPassword.successDescription: Your new password is saved. Log in with it now.
resetPassword.invalidDescription: This link has expired or was already used. Just request a new one.

errors.userExists: There is already an account for this email.
errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.passwordTooShort: Your password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.passwordTooLong: Your password can have at most 128 characters.
errors.emailNotVerified: Please confirm your email address first. We've just sent you a new link.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalidToken: The link has expired or was already used. Please request a new one.
